title: [IMP-05] Set up element work and checklist answers
description:
Source task
PPAP implementation plan / IMP-05

Source plan
docs/phase 2/ppap/solution_specification/implementation-plan.json; plan date 2026-11-17; SHA-256 16059e862dd86c29ccbe374cabe8c001bbdab4667e74f46dadf2122b8f479d54

Task ID
IMP-05

Title
Set up element work and checklist answers

Category
Fields and forms

Objective
Give each governed PPAP requirement a separate work area with the right dates, assignees and typed answers.

Detailed scope
Add PPAP Element and working PPAP Answer fields, related controls and ordinary conditional behavior. Keep required/protected setup and scope-controlled assignment visible to the SIA PPAP Engineer, and show only the matching answer type to the assignee.

Deliverable
Element and answer forms ready for independent native work/review actions.

Work needed first
IMP-01 — Create the PPAP Objects and workflow stages
IMP-02 — Set up PPAP reference lists and operating settings
IMP-03 — Set up PPAP scope and the integrated part warrant
IMP-07 — Set up the governed requirement library
IMP-09 — Set up PPAP templates and their requirement matrix

What the earlier tasks provide
• IMP-01 provides the new Objects, native stage/termination identities and target-record marker.
• IMP-02 provides the seven governed lists and operating-policy fields/default entries.
• IMP-03 provides the PPAP facility/drawing/part/warrant fields and target due/display settings.
• IMP-07 provides the requirement/question authoring and version fields/forms.
• IMP-09 provides the template/matrix authoring and version fields/forms.

What is waiting
Partly waiting: element fields, dates and typed-answer controls can proceed; live eligible role/team/person selections wait for the shared-role references.

Recommended implementer role
Senior Associate Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role
Senior Consultant — PPAP build reviewer (a different person)

Why this role is recommended
The assignment combines established field, related-list and form settings. A Senior Associate Consultant can apply the conditions consistently, with the separate build reviewer checking their effect on the wider process.

Fields and features to set up
PPAP Element.PPAP
Create a link to PPAP, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Enable the reverse read-only list PPAP.Elements. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; creation action binds exact owning record; no later reassignment. Field/control lifecycle: Create Action Handler binds relationship in the authorized creation context; never user-reassign; preserve related-record history.

PPAP Element.Requirement Version
Create a link to PPAP Requirement Version, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Initialize Elements copies exact Template Requirement Version.Requirement Version; never latest on reopen.

PPAP Element.Template Requirement Version
Create a link to PPAP Template Requirement Version, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; required for template-generated elements, NULL for governed additions in Draft. Field/control lifecycle: Initialize Elements stores row that generated work; Add Governed Element in Draft selects active published Requirement Version; unique PPAP+stable Requirement identity. No arbitrary new requirement type.

PPAP Element.Setup Addition Reason
Set the type to Text; up to 2000 characters. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer in Draft; mandatory when Template Requirement Version=NULL; otherwise NULL. Field/control lifecycle: Add Governed Element records reason and exact requirement version; source identity and applicability lock at Issue.

PPAP Element.Required?
Set the type to Yes/No (Boolean). Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: Template Requirement Version applicability evaluation; TRUE for Add Governed Element. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer in Draft only; supplier read only. Field/control lifecycle: Protected requirements cannot become FALSE; FALSE requires Exclusion Reason; after Issue never change.

PPAP Element.Protected?
Set the type to Yes/No (Boolean). Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: Requirement Version.Protected? OR applicable Template Requirement Version.Protected?; absent template row contributes FALSE. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Initialize Elements/Add Governed Element computes combined mandate; requirement-set and flags freeze at Issue.

PPAP Element.Exclusion Reason
Set the type to Text; up to 2000 characters. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer in Draft; required when Required?=FALSE; visible internal and supplier applicable explanation; cleared on Draft change back to TRUE. Field/control lifecycle: Issue retains excluded row and reason as scope evidence; no operational task/reminders for excluded work.

PPAP Element.Work Pattern
Create a link to PPAP Work Pattern, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: Requirement Version.Work Pattern. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; new selection filters Active?=TRUE; preserve existing inactive references read only. Field/control lifecycle: Initialize Elements copies Requirement Version.Work Pattern; issue locks routing pattern.

PPAP Element.Routing Entity
Create a link to Supplier Abstract, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer chooses exact linked depot/facility in Draft; required for SUPPLIER pattern and where internal supplier-specific route applies; otherwise NULL. Field/control lifecycle: Resolve exact-entity Supplier Specific Role; no company/facility/depot fallback; preserve used entity after Issue.

PPAP Element.Assigned Role
Create a link to Supplier Specific Role, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: System resolves exact Routing Entity plus Requirement Version.Routing Role; SIA PPAP Engineer can resolve missing assignment before issue. Field/control lifecycle: Required when pattern SUPPLIER or configured role routing applies; recheck current membership at actions; no automatic fallback.

PPAP Element.Assigned Team
Create a link to Group, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer selects inspection team for Work Pattern.Code=INSPECTION or JOINT; hidden/NULL for other patterns unless requirement config defines internal team. Field/control lifecycle: Current eligible members can act; no copy of members into another group.

PPAP Element.Assigned Person
Create a link to Employee, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer may assign/reassign eligible individual while open; person must remain eligible for entity/team/role context. Field/control lifecycle: Initialize defaults PPAP.Project Owner for INTERNAL when no separate configured route; otherwise NULL leaves current eligible role/team responsible. Issue requires a real eligible route. Assignment handler audits/notifies; no automatic overdue reassignment.

PPAP Element.Schedule Phase
Create a link to PPAP Schedule Phase, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: Template Requirement Version.Schedule Phase, otherwise NULL. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer may assign in Draft or Move Schedule Phase for open schedule-connected work with mandatory reason; supplier read only; new selection filters Active?=TRUE; preserve existing inactive references read only. Field/control lifecycle: Initialize copies Template Requirement Version.Schedule Phase; NULL for manual date rules. Model-specific bulk phase move validates new cell, warns/clears incompatible Manual Due Date only on connected work, recalculates open work; disconnected manual dates await explicit Reconnect; completed/closed work and issued baseline/config lineage preserved.

PPAP Element.Offset Days
Set the type to a whole number (Integer/Int32). Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: Template Requirement Version.Offset Days, otherwise 0. Who can use it and when: Read only for template row; SIA PPAP Engineer in Draft for governed addition. Field/control lifecycle: Integer calendar offset frozen at Issue; may be negative.

PPAP Element.Calculated Due Date
Set the type to Date; no time component; business-day boundary uses PPAP Operating Policy.Business Time Zone. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Initialize/recalculate uses exact Model Change + Schedule Phase + Manufacturing Stage date plus Offset Days; NULL when no connected model rule.

PPAP Element.Manual Due Date
Set the type to Date; no time component; business-day boundary uses PPAP Operating Policy.Business Time Zone. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer while open with mandatory reason; supplier read only. Field/control lifecycle: Manual date used while disconnected or explicit authorized per-element override; clearing warns and returns connected calculation.

PPAP Element.Effective Due Date
Set the type to Date; no time component; business-day boundary uses PPAP Operating Policy.Business Time Zone. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; required for every Required?=TRUE element before Issue; NULL permitted for excluded work. Field/control lifecycle: Date handler uses Manual Due Date if supplied, otherwise Calculated Due Date; connected refresh changes open non-overridden work only. Past dates warn, never block solely for age.

PPAP Element.Issued Baseline Due Date
Set the type to Date; no time component; business-day boundary uses PPAP Operating Policy.Business Time Zone. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; required for required elements after issue. Field/control lifecycle: Issue snapshots Effective Due Date once; never recalculated.

PPAP Element.Date Change Reason
Set the type to Text; up to 2000 characters. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer required on manual date change, Disconnect/Reconnect and bulk updates; internal only; retain last reason otherwise. Field/control lifecycle: Save handler watches Manual Due Date, Effective Due Date and schedule connection action; native audit must retain each old/new date, actor, timestamp and reason.

PPAP Element.Engineer Review Due Date
Set the type to Date; no time component; business-day boundary uses PPAP Operating Policy.Business Time Zone. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; displayed during Engineer Review and historical reports. Field/control lifecycle: Submit/resubmit computes local submission date plus Operating Policy.Engineer Review Days; distinct from supplier due date.

PPAP Element.Submission Comment
Set the type to Text; up to 2000 characters. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Current assignee may edit in Work In Progress; SIA PPAP Engineer read only. Field/control lifecycle: Submit snapshots to Evidence Snapshot.Submission Comment; begin correction prepares fresh value while previous submission stays frozen.

PPAP Element.Working Files
Use the Intelex native attachment collection, retaining file identity, name, length and content type. Do not create a custom file table. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: None. Who can use it and when: Current assignee may edit only Work In Progress while issued PPAP In Progress; supplier uses scope gate on Submit. Field/control lifecycle: Submit copies to fixed Evidence Snapshot.Files; no shared mutable container; clearing working preparation never deletes saved evidence.

PPAP Element.Current Submission
Create a link to PPAP Evidence Snapshot, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Submit stores exact newly frozen saved copy; return preserves it in history; points to current submitted cycle.

PPAP Element.Latest Approved Snapshot
Create a link to PPAP Evidence Snapshot, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Approve Element or Retain Evidence updates after approval; correction reopening retains prior pointer until replacement approval.

PPAP Element.Review Feedback
Set the type to Text; up to 2000 characters. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Responsible SIA PPAP Engineer on Return Element; assignee-visible; required on return; previous feedback retained in native history. Field/control lifecycle: Return writes to current saved copy feedback and workflow history; supplier-safe content only; rework quality separate from timeliness.

PPAP Element.Correction Reason
Set the type to Text; up to 2000 characters. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Responsible SIA PPAP Engineer on Reopen for Correction; required for approved element; otherwise NULL or retained historical reason. Field/control lifecycle: Only before PPAP closure and only same scope/classes/requirement set; never for engineering change; native reopen action binding must be verified.

PPAP Element.First Complete Submission At
Set the type to Date/Time; time-zone support enabled; store UTC, display user zone. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: First successful complete supplier Submit writes once; mandatory file/answer checks precede write; never overwritten by rejection/resubmission.

PPAP Element.First Submission Issued Due Date
Set the type to Date; no time component; business-day boundary uses PPAP Operating Policy.Business Time Zone. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: First complete supplier Submit copies Issued Baseline Due Date for frozen timeliness comparison.

PPAP Element.First Submission Effective Due Date
Set the type to Date; no time component; business-day boundary uses PPAP Operating Policy.Business Time Zone. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: First complete supplier Submit copies Effective Due Date for second frozen timeliness comparison.

PPAP Element.Retained At
Set the type to Date/Time; time-zone support enabled; store UTC, display user zone. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Retain Evidence writes for explicit retained path; does not create a supplier-submission performance event.

PPAP Answer.Element
Create a link to PPAP Element, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Enable the reverse read-only list PPAP Element.Answers. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; creation action binds exact owning record; no later reassignment. Field/control lifecycle: Create Action Handler binds relationship in the authorized creation context; never user-reassign; preserve related-record history.

PPAP Answer.Question Version
Create a link to PPAP Question Version, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Initialize Elements creates exactly one answer per Element+Question Version; resubmission edits same working answer.

PPAP Answer.Answer - Text
Set the type to Text; up to 8000 characters. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Current assignee may edit Work In Progress only; visible when Question Version.Answer Type.Code=TEXT; required only when that type matches AND Question Version.Required?=TRUE; optional matching-type questions remain visible; other types hidden. Field/control lifecycle: Save clears other typed fields only in editable preparation; if published type changes it creates a new Question Version, never mutate old question/answer context. Submit validates the matching value (FALSE and numeric 0 count as answered).

PPAP Answer.Answer - Number
Set the type to a finite number allowing decimals (Float); no silent rounding. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Current assignee may edit Work In Progress only; visible when Question Version.Answer Type.Code=NUMBER; required only when that type matches AND Question Version.Required?=TRUE; optional matching-type questions remain visible; other types hidden. Field/control lifecycle: Save clears other typed fields only in editable preparation; if published type changes it creates a new Question Version, never mutate old question/answer context. Submit validates the matching value (FALSE and numeric 0 count as answered).

PPAP Answer.Answer - Yes or No
Set the type to Nullable Boolean; NULL is unanswered. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Current assignee may edit Work In Progress only; visible when Question Version.Answer Type.Code=BOOLEAN; required only when that type matches AND Question Version.Required?=TRUE; optional matching-type questions remain visible; other types hidden. Field/control lifecycle: Save clears other typed fields only in editable preparation; if published type changes it creates a new Question Version, never mutate old question/answer context. Submit validates the matching value (FALSE and numeric 0 count as answered).

PPAP Answer.Answer - Date
Set the type to Date; no time component. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Current assignee may edit Work In Progress only; visible when Question Version.Answer Type.Code=DATE; required only when that type matches AND Question Version.Required?=TRUE; optional matching-type questions remain visible; other types hidden. Field/control lifecycle: Save clears other typed fields only in editable preparation; if published type changes it creates a new Question Version, never mutate old question/answer context. Submit validates the matching value (FALSE and numeric 0 count as answered).

PPAP.Elements
Create a read-only related-record list over PPAP Element.PPAP; one owning record can show many linked entries (inverse 1:M). Store no second link. Optional navigation only. Apply the owning-record and file permissions; make the list read only and populate it only through the declaring link, with no separate stored value.

PPAP Element.Answers
Create a read-only related-record list over PPAP Answer.Element; one owning record can show many linked entries (inverse 1:M). Store no second link. Optional navigation only. Apply the owning-record and file permissions; make the list read only and populate it only through the declaring link, with no separate stored value.

Build instructions
1. For each working answer, show the field matching Question Version.Answer Type.Code. TEXT uses Answer - Text, NUMBER uses Answer - Number, BOOLEAN uses Answer - Yes or No and DATE uses Answer - Date. Make it mandatory only when that question Required?=TRUE; optional questions remain visible. Clear the other typed fields while preparation is editable. FALSE and numeric 0 are answered values.
2. Set one working answer per Element+Question Version and one element per PPAP+stable Requirement identity. Do not make a new custom status, audit or rejection-log record.
3. Present Required?, Protected?, exclusion/addition reason, assignment and schedule controls with the exact edit restrictions in their rows. Approved evidence and first-submission facts cannot be edited through this work form.

How to check the result
• Optional NUMBER questions remain visible without becoming mandatory, and FALSE passes a required BOOLEAN answer.
• The same question version cannot be added twice to one element; a typed answer does not silently change type when a newer library version is published.

Information needed for this task
IN-05: Supply exact role/team/member selection bindings for Assigned Role, Assigned Team and Assigned Person. Ordinary work/date/answer fields can proceed.
IN-06: Supply the external supplier-user to native person selection connection for Assigned Person on supplier work. Role-based assignments can remain without an individual; ordinary field/answer controls can proceed.

Supplied input context
• IN-05 — Approved SIA roles, supplier roles and capability rules: The SRM/security owners must supply the governed library-role and exact-entity role identifiers, populated memberships, SIA engineer selections, inspection teams/leaders, management approver pool and PPAP administrator group. They must also supply central ACTIVE/SERVICE/INACTIVE capability identifiers and reconcile the annotated central open-work transition rule. These are existing shared authorities; membership administration and central policy decisions are outside the build assignments.
• IN-06 — Record visibility, file access and supplier actor connection: The security/technical team must supply visibility classification values and access rules, native record/file/API/export enforcement methods, authorized handover principals, and the supported external-supplier-user to native actor/recipient identity connection. This information limits the affected security, posting, confirmation and recorded-actor settings.

Specification references
• [Target PPAP technical specification](ppap-target-technical-specification.md)
• [Canonical target field contract](ppap-target-field-contract.md)

Assumptions and open questions
New operational PPAPs only. SIA PPAP Engineer means an internal SIA user; supplier personnel act through their separate supplier roles.
